facts: AI video ad and product photo tool for online stores
Ecommerce sellers, DTC brands and marketers on Shopify, Amazon, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook
6, 10 or 15 seconds; 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9; made from a product photo, a product page link or a text description

faq.a: An online tool that turns a product photo or a product page link into short video ads and store-ready product images for online stores.
Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits. The credit cost of each video or photo is shown before it is made.

faq.q: Does Aidreamcapes add voiceover or music?
faq.a: No. Add sound, music and captions in TikTok, CapCut or another editing app after you download the video.
